description: Apply several edits as one undo step and review them.

identity.goal: Complete the batch edits use case of figcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the figcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `figcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced figcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `figcraft_list_commands`, `figcraft_run_command`, `figcraft_batch`, `figcraft_undo`. Steps: (1) Look up the command ids. (2) Run the edits in one batch. (3) Undo the step if the result is wrong. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace figcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
